court: In the High Court of Madras
judges_raw: (Before Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J. and G. Arul Murugan, J.)
respondents: Bank of Maharastra Rep. by its Chief Manager R. Raju and Others
judgment_text:
PRAYER : Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India seeking issuance of a writ of certiorari to call for the records of the impugned order in Crl. M.P. No. 568/2025 dated 30-1-2026 on the file of the Chief Judicial Magistrate, Kancheepuram, and quash the same as illegal and arbitrary.

The Order of the Court was delivered by

Sushrut Arvind Dharmadhikari, C.J.:— The learned counsel for the petitioners seeks leave of the Court to withdraw the writ petition with liberty to pursue the pending SA before the Debts Recovery Tribunal.

2. The writ petition is dismissed as withdrawn with liberty as prayed for. There shall be no order as to costs. Consequently, WMP Nos. 23156 and 23158 of 202 are closed. W.M.P. No. 23154 of 2026 filed to permit the petitioners to file a single writ petition is allowed, subject to payment of separate court-fee within two weeks.
